title: Fantastic GP practice
content:
The care and advice myself and my daughter received was outstanding! The GP spoke to my daughter taking care she understood the treatments options available to her. She tailored her questions so that my daughter could answer in her own way (selective mutism) 
We are very lucky to have such a fantastic gp practice in Winchester. I would never change and have been a patient for my whole life nearly 39years!
Thank you.
real_data_note: Verbatim real patient review (4-5 star), used as a positive practice exemplar for retrieval grounding. Not an authored policy document.
